बॉलीवु़ड के गलियारों से आ गई है एकदम धांसू खबर, जिसे सुनकर फैंस झूम उठेंगे! 🍿✨
रणबीर कपूर और यश स्टारर मचअवेटेड फिल्म 'रामायण' की एडवांस बुकिंग को लेकर बड़ा अपडेट सामने आया है। 🔥
रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, फिल्म ने टॉप नेशनल चेंस में ताबड़तोड़ कमाई करते हुए 3.25 लाख टिकट बेच लिए हैं। 🎟️
इस शानदार आंकड़े के बाद फिल्म बॉक्स ऑफिस पर एक BANGER ओपनिंग के लिए पूरी तरह से तैयार नजर आ रही है। 🚀
क्या आपने भी इस फिल्म के लिए अपनी टिकट बुक कर ली है या नहीं? नीचे कमेंट्स में जल्दी से बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Ramayana Final Advance Booking: Ranbir Kapoor and Yash starrer sells 3.25 lakh tickets in top national chains, set for BANGER opening
ctx.summary:
Ramayana, starring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Yash, and others, is about to hit the big screens in a couple of hours. The epic saga, directed by Nitesh Tiwari, recorded good advance sales at the ticket window. The movie sold around 3.25 lakh tickets in the top two national chains, PVR Inox and Cinepolis, for the opening day.  
 The sales are lower than the last big Bollywood release, Drishyam: The Conclusion, which sold over 4 lakh tickets. That might be due to the pre-Diwali effect. Among the 2026 titles, Ramayana stands at the third spot among the biggest advances at national chains for the opening days, trailing  Dhurandhar: The Revenge  and  Drishyam: The Conclusion . 
 Based on current trends and sales,  Ramayana  is looking to open around Rs. 55-60 crore nett in Hindi and another Rs. 15 crore nett or so in the dubbed versions. From there, it would be a seesaw trend for the next five days, as it will be dropping one day and then jumping the next. Monday will be the biggest day of the run, as the Hindi circuits will come in full force after the Diwali festivities, and Monday business will be what really sets the tone for what the film can do.  
 Top 3 Advance Bookings at National Chains for Bollywood in 2026 are as follows:
